_comment: FL-4131 W6 admission allowlist contract draft. NOT a runtime enforcement surface yet. The corresponding schema lives at assets/glyphs/schema/admission_allowlist.schema.json. The Python draft validator at scripts/fl4131_admission_check.py exercises the schema only and does NOT scan the live sprite corpus. Phase 2+ runtime (FL-4049 owner lane) will consume this file via a deletion-first compile-identity hash.

allow.reason: Phase 0 reference fixture for the extended-glyph contract; no runtime XP attaches to this entry.
Compile-admission regression fixture: XP source has a valid sidecar and verified terrain.extended.v1 manifest hash.
Static, non-combat sign sprites are the initial admission target for extended-glyph content.

deny.reason: Combat-critical player rig. Extended glyphs must not be admitted here without explicit Phase 3+ approval.

order: any path matching a deny entry is REJECTED regardless of allow entries
any path matching an allow entry is ADMITTED
any other path is REJECTED by default (fail-closed)
resolution_policy.phase_2_runtime_note: Until Phase 2+ runtime enforcement lands, no source XP is actually admitted. The presence of this allowlist is a contract pin; runtime continues to require all XPs to be CP437-only via the VAL-03 legacy path and the FL-4049 Stage B compile-side scan.
